messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Is it possible to change the font?
parts:
I had a dirty hack at
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-examples/blob/master/022-unicode-chinese/global.R
when I wanted to use a Chinese font. The key is that you install the
font to ~/.fonts and run fc-cache there (that is basically how you
install a font under Linux). We should have had a better solution than
that on ShinyApps.io, but unfortunately users do not have much control
over the ShinyApps containers at the moment.

Regards,
Yihui
